instruction: Create a 2-hour Thunderbird Calendar event titled `Doctor appointment` for tomorrow at 9:00 AM. Use Immersive Reader to read the appointment-preparation article, and include the article's exact wording for the items to bring or prepare in the event description.
gt_steps: Open the appointment-preparation AP News article in Microsoft Edge.
Locate the advice about preparing for a doctor appointment.
Enable the `Home` calendar if it is disabled.
Determine tomorrow's date from the Windows system date.
Create a new calendar event for tomorrow at `9:00 AM`.
Set the event duration to `2 hours`.
Set the event title to `Doctor appointment`.
Enter `Bring a list of symptoms and questions` in the event description.
Add `personal medical history` to the event description.
Add `family medical history is critical` to the event description.
Add `Include both prescription and over-the-counter medicines, pills or creams - and don't forget vitamins and supplements` to the event description.
Add `Fill out your paperwork ahead of the visit` to the event description.

rules.title: Doctor appointment
body_points: Bring a list of symptoms and questions
Include both prescription and over-the-counter medicines, pills or creams - and don't forget vitamins and supplements
Fill out your paperwork ahead of the visit
